name: wonder-theme
description: Assistant for the Wonder Shopify theme: search the Wonder docs, check known issues and release notes for your theme version, build custom sections that follow Wonder conventions and pass validation, and update a customised theme to a new Wonder version without losing changes. Connects to the hosted Wonder MCP server (mcp.wonder-theme.com); no account needed.

interface.shortDescription: Build and fix Wonder Shopify theme stores
interface.longDescription: Answers from the official Wonder theme documentation, checks known issues and workarounds for your Wonder version, and builds custom sections that look native to Wonder and pass validation before you paste them into your store.
defaultPrompt: Create a custom Wonder section with three testimonials and a background image.
My mega menu looks blurred on Wonder 2.5.1. Is this a known issue?
How do I open the Wonder cart drawer from my own JavaScript?
Update my customised Wonder 2.4.0 store to the latest version without losing my changes.
